introduction: Georgia LIHEAP applications are handled by local Community Action Agencies. Ask the agency serving your county about the current heating or cooling intake window before submitting records.
description: Georgia LIHEAP applications are handled by local Community Action Agencies. Ask the agency serving your county about the current heating or cooling intake window before submit

sections.who: Applicants must meet household financial and status rules and be responsible for energy costs. The agency checks current eligibility and funding; priority intake may apply to older or medically homebound residents.
sections.get: LIHEAP assists with eligible household energy costs and specified energy emergencies. It is separate from a general application for SNAP or cash assistance.
sections.docs:
• Have the most recent heating or cooling bill and any disconnect notice.
  • Prepare recent income information for household members.
  • Ask the agency which identity and household-status records its current intake requires.
sections.apply:
1. Find your Community Action Agency

    Use the provider information on Georgia’s LIHEAP page.

  2. Ask about the current season

    Confirm opening dates, appointment arrangements and funding. Older state pages show different seasonal calendars, so use the local agency’s current notice.

  3. Submit the local application

    Explain any immediate energy crisis and provide the requested records through the agency’s intake process.
sections.after: Check with the agency about the result and whether a vendor payment has been arranged. Discuss a shutoff separately with your utility while assistance is pending.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Current Georgia LIHEAP overview, Energy eligibility overview. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: The state directs LIHEAP applicants to local Community Action Agencies.
Are dates the same for all applicants?
Georgia describes priority intake for some older or medically homebound residents. Confirm this season’s dates with the provider.
The state says energy assistance and necessary interpreter services are provided without charge.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
